# lab bench

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Benchmark one card with llama-bench (3 repeats), save the output and log it to MLflow. Stops llama-swap so
the card is free, and always starts it again (also on Ctrl-C or kill).
  lab bench 1 "baseline"
  lab bench 2 "ubatch sweep" -ub 512,1024,2048
  MODEL=/models/flint-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf lab bench 1 "flint first look"
  lab bench --dry-run 1 "x"     print the commands, change nothing
Good result: "== results", "Logged run", then "== starting llama-swap".
```

Usage:

```
lab bench [--dry-run] <card 1|2> <note> [llama-bench options]
```
